s00955.summary: Loretta and Artemus trade crossword answers while Caspian types nervously in the corner.
Soaked Jo enters the diner, scanning every face.
Jo crosses to Caspian and presses him about leaving for eight months.
Loretta clumsily interrupts with offers of free pie, amused by the drama.
Jo sits, eats his pie, and says she hates being lied to.
Caspian shuts the laptop and promises Jo the long truth.

s00124.summary: Pryce and Tess silently prepare for the dawn round and fetch poles.
Running feet outside freeze them until the constables pass by.
They step into the grey street and light the first lamps.
Tess asks what happens when lamps light themselves; Pryce answers wryly, and they walk on.

s01860.summary: Pemberton-Hyde enters a faded ballroom and surveys its few lonely guests.
Odette offers punch that turns out to be gravy, to general amusement.
Odette and Pemberton-Hyde dance to Florence's off-key waltz while Barney applauds.

s00767.summary: Archer-Lyle orders silent running and Nolan reports battery status.
Sonar reports an unidentified, stationary surface contact and Nolan plots it.
Nolan raises the periscope and finds the contact is a hospital ship.
A dark destroyer escort appears, then a torpedo is detected heading for the ship.
Archer-Lyle orders the sub into the torpedo's path despite Nolan's objection.
Nolan spins the wheel and the submarine heels across the torpedo's path.

s01540.summary: Amos hauls the ferry rope while silent, armed Jed sits at the far end.
Amos needles Jed about foreign coin and a scarred man who shot a sheriff.
Amos's hand drifts to an axe while Jed's thumb finds the rifle hammer.
Jed and Amos trade wary remarks about the axe until Jed lowers the hammer.
Jed admits he shot the deputy, who had a wife in Muskogee.
Midstream, Amos says he would be within his rights to drown or disarm Jed.
Amos offers the axe handle and names the four hundred dollar bounty and his imprisoned son.
After silence Amos hangs the axe back and resumes hauling toward the far shore.
Jed joins Amos hauling the rope and promises to send word about Amos's son.
The ferry lands, Jed walks into the cottonwoods, and Amos hauls home alone.

s01758.summary: Three keepers wait in the damp tower as the horn sounds without an echo.
Peregrine spots moving lights in the fog while Dagny dismisses him.
Dagny takes the telescope, counts ten approaching lights, and goes silent.
Deaf Sol feels the horn answered by something out on the water.
Dagny seizes the horn lever and Sol grips her wrist to stop her.
The sea moans, the horn hums, and wet footsteps climb the stairwell.
A polite knock comes and a voice like Peregrine's begs to be let in.

s02101.summary: Trevenna presses calm Desiree about the sixty thousand pounds she carried.
Desiree probes how stranded the police are, with no funicular and one bicycle.
Solicitor Violeta arrives and demands release, citing a notarized charity receipt.
Trevenna sighs, unlocks the cuffs, and lets Desiree and Violeta go.

s00889.summary: Soledad teases late, lost Archie in her quiet Lisbon bookbinding workshop.
Archie hands over his grandfather's water-damaged diary and flatters her into taking it.
Aunt Velma bursts in with cod and teases Archie about his wilted daisies.
Archie asks if Soledad likes him; she answers that it takes longer.

s00555.summary: Kaveh claims something big and pale moved past the lamp; Sengupta doubts him.
Sengupta offers tea and notes Kaveh has gone thirty-one hours without sleep.
A vast pale shape glides along the glass that Sengupta cannot name.
A giant ancient eye regards them; Sengupta thinks the creature is curious.
The dome creaks under the creature's flipper and Kaveh urges sealing it.
Sengupta presses her palm to the glass and the creature calms and retreats.
Shaken, they share relief and Sengupta jokes about hating being right at depth.

s01774.summary: Cordelia waits at the left-luggage counter when Rafaela walks in and both freeze.
Rafaela sets down a small case and they speak cautiously about throwing it away.
Both grip Cordelia's suitcase as Rafaela urges her to skip her midnight train.
Rafaela lets go and Cordelia leaves, asking her to keep the case.
Rafaela waits, then leaves the case with the clerk and gets a ticket.

s01702.summary: Imelda makes Bartholomew sit in the floating library and banters cryptically about roads.
Blank pages fill with his dead mother's handwriting, and Imelda says the library keeps the dead alive.
Bartholomew reads his mother's message aloud, moved, and Imelda lets him stay until he stops.

s00898_1.summary: Elijah greets Ruth with a gentle smile and a shotgun held low.

s00156.summary: Five employees in grippy socks sit in a circle at a trampoline park offsite.
They share fears and goals; Paxton claims he has only opportunities.
The group starts bouncing, tie flapping, and Paxton cannonballs in shouting about pyramids.
They stack a clumsy human pyramid that topples into the foam pit.
Marguerite calls it the best meeting ever and everyone surfaces laughing.
A whistle ends the session, and the group heads toward pizza.

s00909.summary: Four soldiers rest in a blossoming orchard trench in a hush of war.
Quigley and Dubois joke about the terrible tea as Morales fidgets with a harmonica.
They discuss the monks who planted the orchard and the records they kept.
A distant rumble fades; a blackbird sings and Morales plays three notes.
They note birdsong in war, and Dubois salutes the trees with his mug.

s01351.summary: Isolated astronomer Cassian works while Lydia, silent, stands below and his mother dozes.
Lydia accuses Cassian of ignoring her letters; he deflects with comet remarks.
Lydia announces her engagement and provokes Cassian into insulting Edgar.
Lydia demands he look at her, and they stand close with wet eyes.
Mabel wakes and wryly says she knew all along.

s00498.summary: Darius cheerfully tempts fate at a children's party with a goat.
The goat Gerald eyes the juice tray, Darius, and the unicorn cake.
Gerald charges the cake as everyone shouts and scrambles.
Frosting rains on the family and a pink Pauline calmly calls it fun.

s01736.summary: Quill haggles over dried fish in a foggy market among giant ribs.
A hooded woman, Zephyrine, corrects their talk of fog and asks for their map.
Toll-keeper Grimbold demands a toll for the ribs and the crew objects.
Zephyrine rises, her candle gutters, and Grimbold bows and steps aside.
Quill hands over the map and the crew exhales.

s00199.summary: Edmund and Cordelia tease quiet Henrietta, noting her fan has stopped.
Henrietta reveals her father accepted an offer from sixty-two-year-old Ravenscroft.
Hobson delivers a sealed letter announcing Ravenscroft died this morning.
Cordelia takes Henrietta's hand as she laughs, then cries.

s01787.summary: A busy farmhouse family gathers in the kitchen as Rosella cooks pancakes.
A pancake lands on the floor, the beagle and Toby scramble, and Harold approves.

s01408.summary: Justice Petrenko presses Desmond on whether his client received legal notice.
Nadine notices a flaw as Desmond argues thousands of cases were never properly closed.
Nadine takes the lectern and explains the misfiled forwarding card to the court.
Oksana silences them and reminds Nadine that Desmond's client lost his house.
Oksana takes the case under advisement and both lawyers exchange a look.

s01261.summary: Kendra phones her father from a laundromat payphone and makes awkward small talk.
Kendra asks about her mother and her father stalls with an evasive voice.
Her father admits he planned to call about her mother in the morning.
Kendra presses her forehead to the tile and says she is coming.
She hangs up gently and folds warm towels, numb.

s00033.summary: Perpetua scolds Bart in the laundromat while a stranger fights a vending machine.
Bart and Perpetua coax Imogen into shaking the machine; the trio speak in unison.
The manager announces machine seven is on fire and Perpetua douses it.
Imogen laughs at the Tuesday fires and offers Bart a pretzel.

s00949.summary: Six crew members play cards and bicker in a cramped deep-sea habitat.
Crew trade quips over cards and coffee until Astrid calls for quiet.
Kamala watches the porthole, a pressure gauge ticks, and Astrid says like a heartbeat.
A long low note rolls through the hull and nobody moves.
Kamala turns, smiling, and explains it is only whales.
